## Somayazulu et al. (2023), BM3 + MGD

Record: `b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1` · Model: `BM3`

**Outcome: Parity not achieved for this comparison.**

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization.
**Comparison basis:** The recorded parameter reconstruction did not meet the audit's agreement criterion; the parameter comparisons retain the actual reconstructed values.

[Stored EOS coefficients and source](../material-summaries/b4c.md#record-b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1)

### What this result establishes

**Separate source-review status:** primary\_source\_validated.
**Usage recommendation:** See the stored EOS qualifications; no recommendation is inferred here.

- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.

### Data and reconstruction method

- **Dataset identifiers:** b4c\_somayazulu\_2023\_table4\_pvt
- **Observations:** 41
- **Fit kind:** joint\_pvt
- **Selection:** 41 heated rows
- **Objective:** errors\_in\_variables
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** q
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; K0; K0\_prime; Tr; theta0; gamma0; n

Unspecified selections, weights, fixed values or error conventions remain unknown; they have not been inferred for this report.

### Curves, residuals and fit error

![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1](figures/b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1-curves.svg#only-light)
![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1](figures/b4c_somayazulu_2023_bm3_1-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Fit | Pressure RMS error (GPa) |
| --- | ---: |
| Original / source fit | 1.39 |
| Reconstruction / refit | 1.3 |

Both fits use the same 41 recovered audit input rows. Residual = P(model) − P(input), evaluated at each input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive pressure error, not a parameter uncertainty or the optimizer's weighted/latent-coordinate objective.

**Volume coordinate:** volume\_a3. **Row selection:** 41 heated rows.

Curves use full stored coefficients. For thermal data, separate isotherms are labelled; when there are more than five temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum sampled temperatures are shown. Residuals include every selected row at its own temperature. Coordinate error bars appear only where the row reader can recover all widths; their meaning remains that of the source dataset (including digitization widths). Missing bars do not mean zero error. No uncertainty band is inferred.
